name: plethora-studio
description: Make a Plethora Bit from your idea and upload it to Plethora Studio as a draft. Bundles the Plethora skill and the Plethora MCP server. No login or API key: you approve a pairing code in the Plethora app.

interface.shortDescription: Upload your idea to Plethora as a draft Bit
interface.longDescription: Tell your agent your idea and say "upload to plethora studio". It builds a Bit for the Plethora phone app, shows you a pairing code to approve in the app, and uploads the Bit as a draft. No login or API key.
defaultPrompt: Turn my idea into a Plethora Bit and upload to plethora studio
Put this on Plethora as a draft
